name: The Good Stuff
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Captain Winky tells me that the Dark Irons in the Depths got all the good stuff. Ain't that right, Winky?

<Oralius does his best impersonation of a pirate.>

ARRR MATEY! IT BE RIGHT!

See what I'm saying? You need to get in there and bring me back some samples of the good stuff.

Get in there and shake your moneymaker!
narrative.objectives: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions.
narrative.offerRewardText:
<Oralius starts rummaging through the mountainous pile of fanny packs.>

OH WONDERFUL!

<Oralius sticks his large nose into the pile and takes a whiff.>

DELICIOUS! Look at all these goodies!

Take one for yourself, adventurer. There's plenty to go around.
narrative.requestItemsText: I can't be bothered right now, adventurer. Me and Winky got a meeting to attend.
